subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this locked, pinned PR-limit announcement remain open as a live contributor-policy notice now that current main and v2026.6.11 document and enforce the 20 cap?
rationale: The source/docs are already synchronized, but Takhoffman reopened and pinned the notice after that docs coverage existed, so automation cannot infer that the issue should now be retired.

options.title: Keep Pinned Notice
options.body: Leave this issue open and locked as the live queue-management announcement while docs and automation remain synchronized.

options.title: Retire In Favor Of Docs
options.body: Unpin and close the issue only after a maintainer confirms CONTRIBUTING.md and automation should be the sole source of truth.

options.title: Change Cap Or Exceptions
options.body: Open focused policy work to change the cap or exemptions consistently across the issue text, docs, workflow, script, and tests.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned Notice
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and locked as the live queue-management announcement while docs and automation remain synchronized.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the visible 20-cap notice change and reopened/pinned the issue after earlier documentation work landed.
